name: TwinCart Hide Selected Categories & Products
author: Twincart

sections.description:
TwinCart Hide Selected Categories & Products gives you control over your WooCommerce shop’s visibility. Hide specific products and categories from the frontend, keeping your catalog focused on what you want customers to see.

Features

  • Global exclusions: select categories and products to hide from all visitors.
  • Subcategories of a hidden category, and all products in them, are hidden too.
  • Product search in the settings, using the standard WooCommerce product search field.
  • Hidden items are removed from shop pages, category archives, search results, related products, up-sells, cross-sells, widgets, the [products] shortcode, navigation menus and sitemaps.
  • Works with WooCommerce blocks: Product Collection, All Products, Product Categories and the Cart/Checkout blocks.
  • Hidden products cannot be added to the cart, and are removed from carts that already contain them.
  • Visitors who open a hidden product or category by direct URL are redirected to the shop page.

WC Compatibility

  • HPOS Compatible: Yes
  • Cart/Checkout Blocks Compatible: Yes
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/twincart-hide-selected-categories-products directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Configure settings under WooCommerce -> Settings -> Hide Categories/Products.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active for this plugin to work.

Who sees the hidden categories and products?

Hiding applies to all visitors of the storefront. The items stay available in the WordPress admin.

What happens to hidden products that are already in a customer’s cart?

WooCommerce removes them from the cart and shows a notice to the customer.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0 (2026-10-07)

  • Initial release.
  • Global category and product hiding, including subcategories.
  • Hiding on shop queries, search results, related products, up-sells, cross-sells, widgets, shortcodes, blocks, the Store API, menus and sitemaps.
  • Add-to-cart protection for hidden products.
  • Direct URL access protection with redirect to the shop page.
  • Declared compatibility with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and the Cart/Checkout blocks.
